summary: The patch addresses the issue of handling `None` estimators when sample weights are provided, but it lacks additional context and tests.

issues.description: The PR does not include additional tests to verify the behavior when some estimators are set to `None` and sample weights are provided. This could lead to future regressions.
There is no update to the documentation or comments to reflect the new behavior of skipping `None` estimators during fitting with sample weights.
